programs.title: Food Safari
programs.desc: Maeve O'Meara explores the world of Danish food, a cuisine crafted for the cold - some dishes date back to the days of the Vikings, others like the sandwich smorrebrod are modern.

programs.title: David Rocco's Eating Dirty
programs.desc: On Eating Dirty, David is in Palermo to enjoy a large selection of deep fried delights, gets into some heavy Tuscan traditional fare on the outskirts of Florence.

programs.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Justine whips up a delicious bacon and egg open pie, her king fish tartare and Michael Moore drops in to make his Moroccan-spiced pumpkin salad.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Adam is joined by two award-winning guests, chef Jason Barratt and poet and comedian Anisa Nandaula, for a night of crowd-pleasing food.

programs.title: Instant Italian
programs.desc: Anna shows how to make two of her favourite easy-lift desserts that are perfect for parties. She begins with a simple, refrigerator-friendly cannoli icebox cake.

programs.title: The Hairy Bikers USA
programs.desc: Bill and Paul roll into Jackson, Mississippi, where the soul food culture is famous for making use of every part of the pig. Many favourite local dishes are made from the least expensive parts.

programs.title: Paul Hollywood Eats Mexico
programs.sub_title: Baja California, Milpa Alta, Oaxaca, Yucatan Peninsula
programs.desc: Paul visits Baja California and tastes fresh cactus in Milpa Alta and insects in Oaxaca, then judges a pasty baking competition in a small mining town.

programs.title: Bring A Plate
programs.desc: The guests are thrilled to try Rachel's South Korean dish, Bossam. Not everyone is able to eat the pork but they can all enjoy and learn about kimchi, the hero of all Korean food.

programs.title: My Market Kitchen
programs.desc: Mike shows off his chef skills by doing a restaurant-quality lamb dish. Chef Tobie Puttock delights us with pipis, pancetta, garlic and bread. Matt is at the Pomona Gin Distillery in Queensland.

programs.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programs.desc: Simplicity reigns in the Italian cuisine, and Lidia is a firm believer that simple cooking is better cooking. She makes a cauliflower orecchiette pasta, crespelle, and discusses crepes.

programs.title: Tom Kerridge's Pub Kitchen Secrets
programs.desc: An Italian-inspired menu in the pub includes an amazing Wild Boar Lasagne.

programs.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programs.desc: Creating family dinners overnight for a family of five, with children of different ages, can be quite the task, and God forbid an Italian cook would prepare separate dinners.
